meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一次代码改动自动生成一条讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需要向团队讲清某次代码改动做了什么
copy.tagline_en: Turn a code change into a narrated explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain what a code change did

howto.what: 把 GitHub PR（PR 链接或 owner/repo#N）读进来，依据 diff、提交和文件，逐帧生成一段代码改动讲解视频，最后渲染出 renders/video.mp4。输入是代码改动，不是网站。
howto.when: 当你给的是 GitHub pull request（PR 链接、owner/repo#N，或已检出仓库里的“this PR”）时接管；其他意图、只说“做个视频”或不确定时，先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这个 PR 做成代码改动讲解视频：acme/sdk#1842
say.note: 先看 BRIEF.md，再从抓取 PR 开始跑流程
据此挑对应 voice id，否则默认女声 Marcia

say.text: 把贡献者头像放进片尾字幕

howto.what_en: Reads a GitHub pull request (PR URL or owner/repo#N) and builds a frame-by-frame explainer video of the code change from the diff, commits and files, rendering renders/video.mp4. Input is a code change, not a website.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give a GitHub pull request — a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or "this PR" in a checked-out repo. Other intents, a bare "make a video", or uncertainty go to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into a code-change explainer video: acme/sdk#1842
say_en.note: Reads BRIEF.md, then starts by ingesting the PR

say_en.text: Use a male voice for the narration
say_en.note: Picks a matching voice id; default is female Marcia

say_en.text: Put contributor avatars in the credits close
